frontiers.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+15%</>.
After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

grizzled-edge.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+8%</>.
When the wearer applies <#ba.crush>Crush</> or <#ba.fracture>Breach</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+[6% × Max number of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks <#ba.consume>consumed</> from one enemy]</> for 20s. If the target already has <#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</>, is <@ba.poise>Staggered</>, or has attached <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</>, increase the aforementioned buff to <@ba.vup>1.5</> times. This buff cannot stack.

type-50-yinglung.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+15%</>. 
When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> that gives DMG <@ba.vup>+20%</> to the wearer's next combo skill. <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> can stack 3 time(s).

bonekrusha.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+15%</>. 
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+30%</>. <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> can stack 2 time(s).

tide-surge.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
After the wearer applies <@ba.key>2</> or more stacks of <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> on the enemy, the wearer gains <@ba.key>Arts DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+35%</> for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

qingbo.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+15%</>.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</> (for every skill) for 15s. This effect can reach 2 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

mi-security.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+5%</>. 
After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+5%</> for 5s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+5%</>. This effect cannot stack.

xiranflow.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+10%</>.
Whenever the wearer <#ba.consume>consumes</> <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG Dealt</> and <@ba.natur>Nature DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+15%</> for 25s. Max number of buff stacks: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

hot-work.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+30</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.burning>Combustion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> +<@ba.vup>50%</> for 10s. After the wearer applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> +<@ba.vup>50%</> for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

lynx.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency <@ba.vup>+20%</>. 
After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains <@ba.vup>15%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for 10s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains <@ba.vup>30%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

swordmancer.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
After the wearer applies a <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Status</>, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals 250% ATK of Physical DMG and [<@ba.poise>10</> Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: 15s.

aethertech.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+8%</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+8%</> for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target already has 4 stack(s) of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 10s. This effect cannot stack.

pulser-labs.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+30</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</><@ba.vup> +50%</> for 10s. After the wearer applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</><@ba.vup> +50%</> for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

eternal-xiranite.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+1000</>.
After the wearer applies <#ba.enhance>Amp</>, <#ba.guard>Protected</>, <#ba.vulnerable>Susceptibility</>, or <#ba.weak>Weakened</>, other teammates gain DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

roving-msgr.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Agility <@ba.vup>+50</>. 
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+20%</>.

aburreys-legacy.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG <@ba.vup>+24%</>. 
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+5%</> for 15s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

armored-msgr.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Strength <@ba.vup>+50</>. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains <@ba.vup>30%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG.

catastrophe.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
The wearer casts a battle skill, the action <#ba.return>returns</> <@ba.vup>50</> SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

mordvolt-resistant.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Will <@ba.vup>+50</>. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect <@ba.vup>+30%</>.

mordvolt-insulation.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Intellect <@ba.vup>+50</>. 
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, <@ba.key>Arts DMG</> <@ba.vup>+20%</>.

aic-heavy.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+500</>. 
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores <@ba.heal>100</> HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5s.

aic-light.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+500</>. 
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+20</> for <@ba.vup>5</>s.

aic-fieldwork.description: 3-piece set effect: Wearer gains DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</> for all types of DMG, <@ba.vup>10%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency <@ba.vup>+10%</>.

deep-rampart.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+16%</>.
When the wearer applies <#ba.naturalburst>Nature Burst</> or <#ba.crystburst>Cryo Burst</>, the wearer gains Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+16</> for 20s. Max stacks for this effect: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.
